---
title: Pasta and Broccoli with Fish
id: MAR-0091
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 55
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 200 g short pasta
- 1 kg fish (ray, scorpionfish or gurnard)
- 400 g broccoli
- 200 g tomato pulp
- 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- 2 anchovy fillets in oil
- 1.5 l fish stock
- 1 garlic clove
## Method
1. Clean the broccoli and divide into florets.
2. Clean the fish, put it in the fish kettle with the court-bouillon, bring to a boil and cook for about 20 minutes.
3. Drain the fish and serve it as a second course.
4. Strain the broth.
5. Peel the garlic and sauté it in a saucepan with the oil; after 4 minutes remove it and, away from the heat, dissolve the chopped anchovy fillets in the oil.
6. Put it back on the stove, add the broccoli florets and the tomato pulp, stir, pour in a liter of fish stock, bring to a boil, add the pasta and cook it for the necessary time.
7. Serve in a tureen.
